PowerShell($routes = @\('/', '/services', '/capacity-building', '/packages', '/contact'\); foreach \($r in $routes\) { $ok = $false; for \($i = 0; $i -lt 15; $i++\) { try { $resp = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000$r" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 5; Write-Output "$r -> $\($resp.StatusCode\) \($\([math]::Round\($resp.RawContentLength/1024\)\)KB\)"; $ok = $true; break } catch { Start-Sleep -Seconds 1 } }; if \(-not $ok\) { Write-Output "$r -> FAILED" } })

PowerShell($ok = $false; for \($i = 0; $i -lt 20; $i++\) { try { $home_ = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000/" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 5; $ok = $true; break } catch { Start-Sleep -Seconds 1 } }; if \(-not $ok\) { Write-Output "SERVER NOT UP"; exit 1 }; $html = $home_.Content; Write-Output "--- geo/meta checks \(home\) ---"; foreach \($needle in @\('geo.region', 'geo.position', 'ICBM', 'application/ld+json', 'LocalBusiness', 'canonical', 'og:image', 'twitter:card', 'GeoCoordinates'\)\) { $found = $html.Contains\($needle\); Write-Output "$needle : $found" }; Write-Output "--- robots.txt ---"; \(Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000/robots.txt" -UseBasicParsing\).Content; Write-Output "--- sitemap.xml \(first 600 chars\) ---"; \(Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000/sitemap.xml" -UseBasicParsing\).Content.Substring\(0, 600\))

PowerShell($conns = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($conns\) { $conns | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force -Confirm:$false; Write-Output "Killed PID $_" } } else { Write-Output "Port 3000 already free" })

PowerShell(Get-ChildItem out | Select-Object Name; Write-Output "---"; Get-ChildItem out -Recurse -File | Measure-Object -Property Length -Sum | ForEach-Object { "Total: $\($_.Count\) files, $\([math]::Round\($_.Sum/1MB,1\)\) MB" }; Write-Output "---"; Test-Path out\\.htaccess; Test-Path out\\services\\index.html; Test-Path out\\404.html; Test-Path out\\sitemap.xml; Test-Path out\\icon; Test-Path out\\opengraph-image)
